name: Lord Ephelion
about: Lord Ephelion is the Arctic Empire's ambassador to Veridia and its public voice, seen mostly on screens and posters. The book never describes his appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Lord Ephelion, Arctic ambassador to Veridia
facts.fact: Arctic ambassador to Veridia; titled Lord.

facts.quote: An image of Lord Ephelion appeared on the left side of the screen
facts.fact: Appears as an image on screens beside his messages.

facts.quote: we have to listen to Lord Ephelion giving his sermons all the time
Ephelion and Delwart are not intellectuals, they are propagandists.

descriptor: a tall, imposing man in his fifties, pale skin with a cool undertone, a sharply chiseled face, long platinum-white hair swept back to the shoulders and piercing pale-blue eyes, wearing a long ice-blue coat of faceted crystalline panels with a towering angular collar framing his head, a short white half-cape over one shoulder, a white seamless bodysuit beneath, silver-traced seams and white gloves
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a tall, imposing man in his fifties, pale skin with a cool undertone, a sharply chiseled face, long platinum-white hair swept back to the shoulders and piercing pale-blue eyes, wearing a long ice-blue coat of faceted crystalline panels with a towering angular collar framing his head, a short white half-cape over one shoulder, a white seamless bodysuit beneath, silver-traced seams and white gloves.
costume_notes: Arctic faceted crystalline panels and a towering collar make the ambassador-preacher look like an icy figure of authority, keeping his ice-blue, white and silver palette and gloves.
